notes.title: Legends of Ethernal - Patch 1.2 - D-BOX haptic feedback support
notes.content:
Patch 1.2 for [b]Legends of Ethernal[/b] is now live on Steam! We are happy to announce that the game is now supporting D-BOX haptic technology! If you have a D-BOX compatible device, you can now enjoy hand-crafted motion made by a team of professionals to offer greater immersion in your adventure through Arkanys!

[h2]PATCH 1.2[/h2]

[h3]CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for D-BOX haptic technology.
[*] Balanced Poison Buff battle.
[*] Kaysers: Reduced attack rhythm and removed swipe attack at Relaxed and Easy Modes.
[*] Dakrei: Reduced poison spit distance.
[*] Brüwig: Added more anticipation before the jump attack.
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the language was not set properly on Steam.
[*] Fixed a possible game freeze related to visual feedback.
[/list]

notes.title: Legends of Ethernal - Patch 1.1 - Difficulty balancing update
notes.content:
[b]Legends of Ethernal[/b] is already one week old! We hope you have fun playing the game! We received feedback from players finding that it is too hard, even at the Relaxed Mode difficulty. We want people to enjoy the game as it should be, based on the selected difficulty they want and expect, so we decided to put out a patch to balance difficulty in the game while doing some bug fixes.

- The Lucid Dreams Studio Dev Team

[h3][b]PATCH 1.1[/b][/h3]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Balanced general difficulty in Relaxed Mode, Easy, Normal, Hard and Hardcore based on players' feedback.
[*]Added more ether drops through the game, especially in the Dark Forest area.
[*]Removed permadeath in Hardcore mode.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Spiders: Fixed a bug where spiders would exhibit unwanted behaviour when stunned.
[*]Fixed some typos in French localization.
[/list]

notes.title: First announcement on Steam
notes.content:
